description: 176 tests: fixed unified model routing - skip content-length header copy so reqwest auto-sets correct length after model name replacement

asi.hypothesis: Fixed unified model routing: 1) Skip content-length header copy so reqwest auto-sets correct length after model name replacement. 2) Use tokio::time::timeout for DB queries. 3) Keep old code order (select provider first, then read body)
asi.root_cause: Content-Length mismatch: original body had model 'aa' (61 bytes), but after replacement body had 'MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed' (87 bytes). Forwarded request kept old Content-Length=61, causing upstream to truncate JSON at byte 61.
asi.fix: Skip content-length header in proxy forwarding, let reqwest auto-calculate
